programme.title: 蠍子戰士
programme.desc: Fei comes to Hong Kong with his son Yushu and winds up a back-alley barber. Yushu is now in high school but he only likes to draw pictures. He also is hot blooded, thus often getting into fights. By accident, Yushu meets beautiful Ru. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 夏日的麼麼茶
programme.desc: Summer flies to an island to sell a resort that is invested by her and her cousin. She meets Momocha who claims to be the authentic owner of the hotel. They begin a battle of love..

programme.title: 奇門遁甲
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector..

programme.title: 影人映語 -關錦鵬
programme.desc: “Rogue”, one of the most significant film of Director Stanley Kwan, earned him the Best Director and made the characters “Fleur” and “Chan Chen-Pang” a legend. He reveals the story behind the film's directorial position and the obstacles he encountered along the production, as well as talking about his delicate sense of portraying women's stories.

programme.title: 地下情
programme.desc: Billie Yuen and her two friends Liao Yu Ping and Zhao Shu Ling who came from Taiwan, share the same ideal to become famous. The three women met Tony Cheung who is the son of a rice wholesaler at a bar. Tony was madly clung to the indifferent dressing Billie and then they cohabit. The four friends spent a good night at Liao's home, celebrating her birthday. One night, when Liao came home late, Zhao was found being murdered. Liao was filled with great sorrow. The three friends received Sergeant Lan's inquiry individually. Liao felt depressed since her best friend conceals everything. Tony accompanied Liao back home, the sight stroke a chord in her heart and Tony tried hard to comfort her, then they had sex. Liao was pregnant, it shocked Billie, whereas Tony felt difficult to choose. Finally both Liao and Billie left Tony and the three noticed the one they love the most is-themselves.

programme.title: 衛斯理之老貓
programme.desc: One night, disturbing noise comes from an upstairs flat. Lee Don decides to go up and caution the noise-makers. He sees there are an old man, a young girl and a black cat. But Lee Don discovers that the flat is completely deserted on the next day. A cat's innards, however, are left behind. Lee Don tells this to Wisely, famous for his adventures. Wisely gets suspicious. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. An outer space killer takes possession of a police officer's body and tries to wipe them, including Wisely..

Smash-head is a CID officer. Wracked by insecurity he believes the world will be destroyed by pollution. That's why he's an environmentalist. Carmen is a child psychologist. She specializes in hypnotism, her world is full of grace and vitality. That's why she believes in love. The two meet during a police chase. When Smash-head kills a hostage he mistakes as a kidnapper, he is put under internal investigation. And his superior tries to drag him into a corrupt syndicate. With no way out, he turns to Carmen. Under hypnotism, he remembers his long forgotten past and the image he had of himself as a young and enthusiastic fighter for justice. Holding on to this memory and the love of Carmen, he takes his pistol, number 9413..

programme.title: 夜車
programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之二男兒當自強
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: 暴風眼
programme.desc: Few years ago, Sergeant Kong in a mission to capture the head of the “East Rail Corporation” met with Yip Fung who killed the head of East Rail instead. Kong shot at Yip but missed and only a finger was left in the scene. Kong suspected that Yip might be a robot and thus kept a close watch on her, but later turned that he fell in love with Yip. One night, Ko Kit accompanied with four assistants launched a campaign to steal the “Crystal” in East Rail Main Building. Ko was successful in breaking through the security system and got the crystal but at the same time Yip also rushed to join in the robbery..

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 星願
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.

programme.title: 黑俠
programme.desc: Li was part of “Squad 701”, a team of professional killers known as Black Mask, who do not feel pain or emotions. When the team was “exterminated” by the government after they discovered that some squad members are still capable of feelings, Li goes into hiding as a librarian. However, when another member of the Squad begins killing every major drug market, Li has to don the identity of Black Mask once again..

programme.title: 霹靂大喇叭
programme.desc: Tuba is a policeman, but because of his timid character, he spends his days in the Police Band as a tuba player. Inspector Chow sees the potential in Tuba and arranges him to investigate the case together. Unfortunately, Chow gets killed at work, but his ghost helps Tuba to crackdown on the villains..

programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: The Buddhist Monk and the Taoist Priest, both blessed with ghost-taming powers, have been quarrelling all over the landscape. Still, they are good friends. The Priest shepherds a group of corpses home. He has to fight off some vicious devils. The Priest's classmate has been assigned the job of accompanying the coffin of a prince back to the capital. One night, a thunderbolt rips the coffin and the prince becomes a vampire. He kills many people. The Priest asks to help. He finds his classmate has killed himself..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之二男兒當自強
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: 新最佳拍檔
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak to steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove. White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: 十二夜
programme.desc: 12 particular nights, from falling in love to drifting apart to a tentative separation and, to the inevitable split, these nocturnal passages encapsulate the entire experience.

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..

programme.title: Office有鬼
programme.desc: In every lunar July, there would be nine persons died in this building and no one knows the reason. Ken came to this building for interview. He saw several ladies talking about ghost story in the lobby. Amongst the ladies, he found his old girlfriend, Pat and another attractive girl who was wearing a red dress..

credits.director: 麥子善, 劉寶賢, 不是女人

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 愛情謎語
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends..

programme.title: 新最佳拍檔
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak to steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove. White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: This is the story of four aspiring young men striving to fight for their own goals. Kui and his family are intent upon emigrating to another country and they put all their energy in making as much money as possible in order to leave Hong Kong sooner. However just as their goal is about in sight, over-exertion causes Kui to fall ill...Keung is a smart and aggressive young man whose ambition is to make it in the world. But misfortune descends upon him when discovering that he and his family are duped by his boss...It has been a childhood dream of Chung to join the police force but his fragile frame of a body is far from satisfactory, so he turns to conducting traffic and handing out tickets to unfortunate drivers amid the bustles of the streets. However, his virtue is not appreciated...Wing is a diligent and self-absorbed student. His goal is to be one of the chosen few at his college's Music Department but he is dissuaded by his girlfriend's father. In the end he gives in and.

programme.title: 八星報喜
programme.desc: Fai, the eldest, has met Fong. Long is a guy with many girl-friends. A girl working in a deparment store has become his target. Sung, is a timid artist. Ying comes into his life..

programme.title: 愛情謎語
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends..

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 英雄本色III
programme.desc: The year is 1974. A young Hong Kong Chinese, Mark, travels to Saigon to make his fortune. There, he encounters a mysterious femme fatale, the lovely Kit. As he becomes more involved in her various underworld deals, a tragic romance develops. On the eve of the outbreak of war, Kit's past returns to endanger her, and Mark must risk everything for the one true love of his life..

programme.title: 飛躍羚羊
programme.desc: Alias “Springing Gazelle”, the renowned athlete Miss Chi Cheng is in Hong Kong helping to organize a training programme and hunt for a coach. Olivia was a former brilliant sprinter who has to give up running after her injury in a competition. At the beginning of the training, the girls are too pompous that they despise Olivia, until they find that Olivia is beyond their challenge, they adore her and are willing to go through the hardship but after a winning contest, they feel hostility towards each other and behave proudly. As a result, they lost in the competition with Singapore team. Olivia is so furious..

programme.title: 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.title: 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious..

programme.title: 神勇飛虎霸王花
programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them..

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely..

programme.title: 監獄風雲
programme.desc: The plot mostly involves the two main characters, Ching and Yiu and problems they face with Mickey, a fellow inmate and “Scarface”, a high-ranking officer. Yiu is sentenced to three years for manslaughter. In a fight for his father, he kicked a man onto the path of a bus. Ching was sent to prison for killing his wife for being a prostitute. During the end of the film, inmates decide to go on hunger strike to protest against the cigarette price rise, this causes problems with “Assassin”. Ching bit “Scarface”‘s ear off and gets an extended sentence, Yiu is released from the prison.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Part Two of our Kamilaroi Highway road-trip starts in Lightning Ridge and wraps up in\nBourke, and we’re blessed with more sensational countryside, and the awesome stories that make\nthis area of Australia so popular. This is a part of Australia everyone needs to discover.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken\nby European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in\nthe very interior of the country.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第5集 -Hadrian’s Wall - Chesters Roman Fort and Carlisle
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette are heading to Britain’s most spectacular and best-preserved Roman frontier - Hadrian’s wall. They will scour the two rivers that flow along its path looking for lost evidence from the might of 2nd century Rome and the invaders’ brutal occupation of Britain.

programme.title: Danger Decoded 第1季

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Texas has a feral pig problem. They can tear up a farmer's field faster than a herd of rototillers. Scott and Scott's son, Jake, head out at night to kill hogs that will be used to feed a church group in Brownsville.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. Not to back down from a challenge, Cal shows how it's done. They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first 5 seasons of Dead Meat and features 'The Good, the Bad, and the Slimy.' The journey has been full of surprises, but they weren't all good.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第2季
programme.desc: From Sydney to the Greater Blue Mountains, Zac and Darin meet with leading eco-warriors to learn about protected lands and habitat conservation.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第2季
programme.desc: Zac and Darin get down and dirty as they explore a natural approach to farming through regenerative agriculture and organic food production.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第6集 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.desc: Tropical North Queensland is a region of lush rainforests, stunning beaches and rich indigenous history. In this episode, we explore the best activities on offer in this remarkable place. programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.sub-title: Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory
programme.desc: In this installment, we highlight the top experiences available in Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. programme.desc: Sara drives to East Kimberley, soaking in the scenery of the Cockburn Range mountains. Sara is so inspired by the communal spirit at Home Valley Station that she contributes by hosting a pizza night - with a wood fire oven crocodile pizza.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季
programme.sub-title: Western Australia: More Than Meets The Eye
programme.desc: Sara goes to Yawuru conservation park to try and catch some mud crabs with cultural guide Bart, who is originally from Broome.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第2季
programme.desc: If you thought samba and soccer were what Sao Paulo was famous for, think again. It's also known as home to the worst traffic jams in the world.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken\nby European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in\nthe very interior of the country.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Central Victoria is ‘river & ranges country’, and is an easy drive out of Victoria’s capital, Melbourne. Epic scenery, outstanding natural beauty, lots of history, and down to earth hospitality, our road-trip through Central Victoria does not disappoint.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第2季
programme.desc: Oscar-nominated actress Kate Hudson goes on a journey with Bear that involves a treacherous mountain range in Italy; Kate shares details of her unique upbringing.

programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.desc: Tropical North Queensland is a region of lush rainforests, stunning beaches and rich indigenous history. In this episode, we explore the best activities on offer in this remarkable place. Experience the magical coral gardens of the Great Barrier Reef, see the Daintree Rainforest come to life on a nocturnal tour, and witness some of the nation’s oldest rock paintings at Jarramali bush camp.

programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.sub-title: Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory
programme.desc: In this installment, we highlight the top experiences available in Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. From the pristine waters of the Sapphire Coast to the snow-capped peaks of Mount Kosciuszko, there is so much to discover. Ride through the majestic Snowy Mountains on horseback, learn about the fascinating lifecycle of an oyster in Pambula and immerse yourself in an indigenous cultural tour in Australia’s capital city, Canberra.

programme.title: Million Dollar House Hunters 第1季
programme.desc: Today on Million Dollar House Hunt we meet house hunter Bec and her son Quin who are looking for a multi million dollar property in Toorak, Melbourne.

programme.title: Million Dollar House Hunters 第1季
programme.desc: Today on Million Dollar House Hunt we meet house hunters Axle and Maree who are looking for a multi million dollar property in Seddon, Melbourne.

programme.title: Ultimate Freedive 第1季
programme.desc:
World champion freediver Marina Kazankova is on a mission, to free dive the Great Barrier Reef.

Capable of holding her breath for 7-minutes at a time, Marina travels to the iconic reef, swimming with turtles and giant groper, diving on ship wrecks and through awesome caves, all on a single breath of air.

Capturing each challenge in glorious 4K, this series brings you face to face with the very best of the Great Barrier Reef’s corals and creatures.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport 第1季
programme.desc:
Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was 
planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of 
Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of 
Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar 
bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, 
Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical 
planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to 
carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a 
Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where 
the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. There’s still a long way to go to 
Ontario and they need to feed this hungry polar bear. It’s 11pm and there’s a supermarket 
close to the.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport 第1季
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第6集 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Texas has a feral pig problem. They can tear up a farmer's field faster than a herd of rototillers. Scott and Scott's son, Jake, head out at night to kill hogs that will be used to feed a church group in Brownsville.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first 5 seasons of Dead Meat and features 'The Good, the Bad, and the Slimy.' The journey has been full of surprises, but they weren't all good.

Never-before-seen behaviours have been documented by a team of five cinematographers over the three-month whale season in Hervey Bay, all captured in glorious 4K. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before.

programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.desc: Tropical North Queensland is a region of lush rainforests, stunning beaches and rich indigenous history. In this episode, we explore the best activities on offer in this remarkable place. Experience the magical coral gardens of the Great Barrier Reef, see the Daintree Rainforest come to life on a nocturnal tour, and witness some of the nation’s oldest rock paintings at Jarramali bush camp.

programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.sub-title: Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory
programme.desc: In this installment, we highlight the top experiences available in Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. Ride through the majestic Snowy Mountains on horseback, learn about the fascinating lifecycle of an oyster in Pambula and immerse yourself in an indigenous cultural tour in Australia’s capital city, Canberra.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport 第1季
programme.desc:
Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was 
planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of 
Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of 
Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar 
bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, 
Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical 
planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to 
carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a 
Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where 
the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. There’s still a long way to go to 
Ontario and they need to feed this hungry polar bear. It’s 11pm and there’s a supermarket 
close to the.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport 第1季
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts.

programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken\nby European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in\nthe very interior of the country.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Central Victoria is ‘river & ranges country’, and is an easy drive out of Victoria’s capital, Melbourne. Epic scenery, outstanding natural beauty, lots of history, and down to earth hospitality, our road-trip through Central Victoria does not disappoint.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第6集 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.desc: A quick stop for gas turns into a parent's worst nightmare when a 6 year old boy is snatched during a carjacking. Meanwhile, Sunny fights back intrusive thoughts with self-defense classes, and Matt seems to be ready to move on from Tess- but who is he dating...

programme.desc: During a routine interview at a chemical plant, Tess and Leo are trapped by a gunman looking to kill the plant's manager. Tess and Leo's attempt to evacuate the target and other workers safely is cut short when Leo is shot and injured, leaving Tess and Sunny to outsmart the gunman, escape the lockdown, and save the day. With unexpected help from Matt and Mia, Sunny guides Tess around the highly flammable plant to save Leo's life and uncover the gunman's motive before he blows them all up. Tess and Sunny are both blindsided by unsettling news as Lucas shares plans to get married, and Sunny finally uncovers Rigby's secret.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦中國傳統色彩中的黃色與紅色，展現帝王專屬色如何融入民間生活。通過植物提取黃色、緙絲技藝、香港書法家華戈的朱砂紅招牌等案例，詮釋色彩的文化演變。運用動畫及光影設計，突顯青花瓷等器物的古典美感.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦中國人通過色彩與天地溝通的智慧，展現傳統色在宗教儀式、祭祀活動中的神秘意涵。通過五行哲學與自然崇祀案例，闡釋色彩作為天人合一理念的物質載體，揭示先民以色譜構建精神世界的審美哲思.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 今集講述有一位小鄰居覺得爸爸媽媽，甚至連婆婆都不疼愛她。因為媽媽不給零用錢，婆婆也不理她，感到失去原有的「福利」。到底「福利」是不是應該永遠不變呢？. 所以，貓頭鷹博士登場，引用《基本法》第一百四十五條，帶領芊穎重新思考。究竟這次是父母真的不再疼愛她，還是一場誤會？. 《基本法》第一百四十五條:. 香港特別行政區政府在原有社會福利制度的基礎上，根據經濟條件和社會需要，自行制定其發展、改進的政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: An increasing number of people are viewing AI as a "confidant" for sharing their innermost thoughts and seeking emotional support. Tech companies like Gemini, Grok, and Google are racing to enhance AI's psychological features. This reflects not just technological advancement, but a deep-seated demand for emotion and connection in modern life. . This episode explores extreme global cases stemming from AI emotional companionship, highlighting news stories of overreliance and fraud to warn against potential risks. Additionally, cybersecurity experts offer insights into privacy concerns and authenticity issues that users must navigate when relying on these "AI confidants.

programme.sub-title: The Lam Tsuen River Keeps the Flow
programme.desc: The Lam Tsuen River originates from Tai Mo Shan with its watercourse stretching over 10 kilometres. It flows through Chai Kek, Tong Min Tsuen and the town centre of Tai Po, before it finally reaches Tolo Habour. It is a river weaving through both forested and urban areas, nurturing unique cultural landscapes. Chai Kek at the upstream is one of the few places in Hong Kong that retains the original landscape of natural rivers and streams. Ecologist Dr Ken SO leads urban dwellers into the riverbed to feel in person the temperature of the flowing water and its breath of life, and explore the biodiversity therein. She Shan Tsuen at the midstream is a Hakka village with a history of over 200 years. The trees in the Fung Shui wood on the hillside behind the village were planted by the ancestors of the village representative CHAN San-kwai. The trees not just block the wind and stabilise the land, but also have their own uses. One huge old camphor tree in the wood, which is even older than the village itself, has become the collective memory of villagers. Wallace is a ceramic artist deeply inspired by the Lam Tsuen River. He uses clay to record textures of the nature. He wanders into the Fung Shui wood and transforms the trees and clay into artworks carrying memories. The river continues its journey through the urban areas of Tai Po and reaches Tolo Harbour. The Coral Academy of the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department are now working together in remediation for the harbour to restore the beauty of this underwater garden where coral once flourished. Life needs to be nurtured, and so does the river. The Lam Tsuen River is not just a waterway, it is also a story intertwining human and the nature.

programme.title: 不完美受害人
programme.sub-title: 第十六集: 成功要拿回董事長的權位
programme.desc: 因為案件唯一的知情人尹聲未能向警方提供有利於趙尋的證據證詞，成功獲釋。回家後成功要求辛路取消罷免他的決議，重新選舉董事長，拿回他的權位.

programme.title: 不完美受害人
programme.sub-title: 第十七集: 林闞名利雙收
programme.desc: 林闞拿幫成功洗脫罪名，重獲清白，她也獲得巨額律師費。林闞建議成功和趙尋簽署一份“封口協定”，約定雙方不對外洩露事件經過和刑偵細節、不曝光對方個人資訊隱私，成功不置可否，表示考慮。結案後，林闞與晏明邂逅，法學院師姐妹並沒有消除隔閡.

programme.desc: 距離本地賽尚餘一星期，各隊仍然忙於精修機械人。可是，仍有冠軍大熱未能完成門檻任務——組裝武器。究竟發生何事？. 來自九間院校的十五支隊伍，奮戰一年，終於走上擂台，爭奪代表中國香港出戰國際賽的兩席位。本集精選關鍵賽事，並由隊員親述幕後故事。. 只要認真一戰，人人都是自己心目中的「武林至尊」.

programme.title: 太陽小記者- 2026西域記
programme.desc: 新彊吸引之處在於其多元文化；從熱情奔放的民族風情，到巧奪天工的非遺手藝，非遺文化不只是博物館裏的展品，太陽使者透過親身體驗，感受活在當下的文化傳承。他們又到訪林則徐紀念館，凝視着一件件珍貴的歷史文物，深切感受林則徐的愛國情懷與浩然正氣。到了旅程最後一站–結業禮，大家懷著興奮的心情把成品展示，也帶著不捨的淚水互相祝福，旅程雖然結束了，但這份難離難捨的羈絆，已經深深烙印在他們的青春裏。《太陽計劃》留給大家的，不只是一趟旅程，而是日後點亮人生的珍貴片段，回憶那年盛夏的暑假，他們在新疆遇上了一段燦爛之旅，燦爛的不只是風景，是踏出去的勇氣。. 主持：阮頌陽嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.title: 周末大電影：神奇兩女俠
programme.desc: 梁好逑(鄭裕玲飾)和連子蓉(葉童飾)為了改善生活，不約而同角逐香港小姐。選美前夕她們成為大小報紙的熱門話題，揭曉當晚她倆卻名落孫山。連子蓉被男友拋棄，為同病相憐的梁好逑所收留。次日，連子蓉返公司銷假時遭同事奚落，憤然辭職；梁好逑也因到電視臺試鏡被人譏笑。共同的遭遇使兩人成為好友。某日，一個自稱是日本華僑的青年(王敏德飾)闖入她們的圈子裡，成為她倆共同追逐的對象。在明爭暗鬥中兩人終於決裂。不久，青年突然離去，原來他竟是一個遊手好閒之輩；這對她倆猶如大夢初醒。最後，她們都找到了新工作.

programme.desc: 「乾淨」不只是洗手！到底什麼是「精神潔癖」？ 後疫情年代，你是否也成了「消毒狂人」？洗手洗到脫皮、見到污糟就心慌？原來「潔癖」不止關乎衛生，背後更是對安全感與確定感的追求！ 今集《非凡人物》請來人文學講座教授文潔華，和作家米哈、臨床心理學家梁重皿及大學講師葉德平，暢談潔癖文化 —— 由古人的潔癖，再到現代社會如何用「乾淨」劃分階級。是否觸及社群的道德底線就要被「取消」？什麼是「取消文化」？ 想睇更多： https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/theextraordinary 逢星期六、日｜下午 1:05 ｜港台電視 31 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg 記得 LIKE +訂閱 + 推播通知！ #非凡人物 #潔癖文化 #文潔華 #米哈 #葉德平 #梁重皿 #清潔 #整潔 #洗手 #斷捨離 #社會階級 #精神潔癖 #道德 #取消文化 #港台電視31.

programme.sub-title: 第五集：曾倩弟弟下落不明
programme.desc: 登州城失蹤的百姓回來之後全部失憶，唯不見曾信，但城池這時又再不見了。經分析，眾人決定從無極觀入手。另一邊，封不害向失憶的童童坦露了自己的真實身分，童童答應保守秘密。及後，封不害夜訪林寒欲為劉冠英報仇，卻反被林寒要脅。同時，曹晟等人正想方法潛入無極觀.

programme.title: 時事摘錄
programme.desc: 「時事摘錄」擷取每週寰宇新聞及本港大事精華，詳盡報導；為進一步令香港達致無障礙城市目標，「時事摘錄」更提供現場手語傳譯及字幕，方便聽障人士收看。. 1.陳國基：重建後皇崗口岸運作順暢有信心可應付重陽節周末人流. 2.李家超：香港要敢於打破壁壘引資本注入創科領域. 3.政府推售石門住宅地料可提供960個單位. 4.孫玉菡：外傭政策須公平無意引入試用期. 5.港鐵藍田站連續兩日事故影響列車服務. 6.多間巴士營辦商申請加價加幅8.1%至17.7%. 7.本港三家免費電視台獲批續期12年放寬措施營造有利營商環境. 8.梵蒂岡：教宗確診肺腺癌手術成功割除部分右肺.

programme.desc: 四強決戰迎來最終考驗，一波未平一波又起！有隊伍內部撕裂爆發，拍攝現場陷入異常沉寂；有隊伍則過分專注「搞設備」引致嚴重疏忽。面對嚴厲質疑與層出不窮的突發狀況，同學們如何在絕境中重拾默契，化解危機，完美逆轉局勢.

programme.desc: 「乾淨」不只是洗手！到底什麼是「精神潔癖」？ 後疫情年代，你是否也成了「消毒狂人」？洗手洗到脫皮、見到污糟就心慌？原來「潔癖」不止關乎衛生，背後更是對安全感與確定感的追求！ 今集《非凡人物》請來人文學講座教授文潔華，和作家米哈、臨床心理學家梁重皿及大學講師葉德平，暢談潔癖文化 —— 由古人的潔癖，再到現代社會如何用「乾淨」劃分階級。是否觸及社群的道德底線就要被「取消」？什麼是「取消文化」？ 想睇更多： https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/theextraordinary 逢星期六、日｜下午 1:05 ｜港台電視 31 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg 記得 LIKE +訂閱 + 推播通知！ #非凡人物 #潔癖文化 #文潔華 #米哈 #葉德平 #梁重皿 #清潔 #整潔 #洗手 #斷捨離 #社會階級 #精神潔癖 #道德 #取消文化 #港台電視31.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第三百二十三集 - 「兩隻小刺蝟」上集
programme.desc: 第三百二十三集-「兩隻小刺蝟」上集. 【故事時間】「兩隻小刺蝟」上. 兩隻小刺蝟分別住在相隔千里的東西兩邊，牠們各自心中都渴望找到一個真正的好朋友，於是毅然踏上冒險之路。隨著旅程推進，彼此距離漸漸拉近，但路途卻困難重重，危機四伏。究竟牠們能否克服重重障礙，成功靠近對方？. 編導：蔡少傑.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第三百二十四集 - 「兩隻小刺蝟」下集
programme.desc: 第三百二十四集-「兩隻小刺蝟」下集. 【故事時間】「兩隻小刺蝟」下. 故事進入最驚險的階段！兩隻小刺蝟竟被怪魚一口吞落肚，危在旦夕。牠們該如何逃出生天？路途上又會再遇上什麼怪獸？最重要的是——牠們最後究竟能否找到對方？結局充滿轉折與驚喜，故事結尾有彩蛋。. 【冷知識】「黑臉琵鷺的秘密」. Wheel仔戴著望遠鏡準備去觀鳥，卻被碌碌姐姐撞個正著！兩人究竟會揭開黑臉琵鷺什麼不為人知的秘密？最後又發生了什麼令人意想不到的事？. 編導：蔡少傑陸素嫻.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第三百二十五集 - 【航天大解密「上太空會令到身體變型？」／手作EASY JOB「夾公仔神器」／成語畫畫郎「亡羊補牢」】
programme.desc: 第三百二十五集-【航天大解密「上太空會令到身體變型？」／手作EASY JOB「夾公仔神器」／成語畫畫郎「亡羊補牢」】. 【航天大解密】「上太空會令到身體變型？」. 飛上太空後，身體真的會改變？會變高、變矮，還是有其他意想不到的變化？本集航天大解密將揭開這個有趣的謎團，帶領小朋友認識太空環境對人體的影響，啟發對太空探索的無限好奇。. 【手作EASY JOB】「夾公仔神器」. 今集手作環節別出心裁！小朋友將動手製作「夾公仔神器」。看似簡單的物料，經過巧妙設計後，竟能變成實用又好玩的工具。究竟完成後會變成怎樣？家中的小朋友亦可一同嘗試，挑戰自己的手作功力。. 【成語畫畫郎】「亡羊補牢」. 傻傻的碌碌遇上奇怪的畫畫郎！畫畫郎把「亡羊補牢」巧妙藏在畫中。即使碌碌再怎麼傻，只要願意改進，就永遠有得救的機會。一起跟隨他揭開畫中的秘密吧.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第三百二十六集 - 【嘉賓來了】香港陶笛演奏家 - 原樂天
programme.desc: 第三百二十六集-【嘉賓來了】香港陶笛演奏家-原樂天. 【嘉賓來了】. 今集邀請香港陶笛演奏家原樂天（Sunny）蒞臨BobieLand。他將帶來優美的陶笛演奏，並分享學習陶笛的心路歷程。小小的陶笛，竟能吹奏出如此動人的旋律？透過現場表演與趣味互動，小朋友將親身體會音樂的魅力，感受堅持練習帶來的驚喜與感動。. 編導：蔡少傑.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第三百二十七集 - 【玩轉星期五】終極大抽獎
programme.desc: 第三百二十七集-【玩轉星期五】終極大抽獎. 【玩轉星期五】. 玩轉星期五遊戲環節精彩登場！小朋友將分成兩組，參與三個回合的鬥智鬥力鬥運氣的遊戲挑戰，包括「乾坤大挪移」、「攻呀攻，快搶攻」及「終極大抽獎」。透過運氣、團隊合作、反應力與策略比拼，每一回合都充滿變數，誰能笑到最後獲得Bobieland大遊玩卷呢？. 編導：蔡少傑.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 美麗與可愛因人而異。真正的可愛不只是外表，還包括有趣的行為和生存技巧。從本能求生的狐獴，到腹部滑行的小水獺，再到大熊貓寶寶，這些動物寶寶憑藉無可抗拒的魅力，躋身十大最可愛動物寶寶排行榜.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: Harry 哥哥最近化身神探Harry，專門到不同學校為小鄰居排難解紛。第一集就到大埔浸信會公立學校幫助小鄰居俊仔！. 俊仔滿腔熱血，擁有一顆樂於助人的心，發夢都想做班長。誰知他的偉大抱負換來的卻是同學們反對！理由竟然是：「你又不是模範生，憑什麼選班長？」難道真的要科科考第一，才有資格成為候選人？俊仔的「班長夢」難道就此幻滅？. 不過，貓頭鷹博士為大家拆解《基本法》第二十六條，解決大家的疑惑！今集就與Harry 哥哥一同走入大埔浸信會公立學校，踏上一個關乎夢想、規則與公平的旅程！. 《基本法》第二十六條：. 香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 追夢者
programme.sub-title: Leo Chan : Sky Has No Limit
programme.desc: ”When you are not afraid, anything is possible.” - Leo Chan. Passionate about leveraging new technologies, Leo Chan is a founder of a firm aiming to introduce innovative changing solutions to every day's technology products. He is a person with a growth mindset. He often pushes himself out of his comfort zone, like participating in Triathlon, and recently, finished a swimming relay across the English Channel. . Leo is bold to explore and is striven to find new opportunities in different regions like Shanghai and Singapore. His dream is to teach or share with others what he is good at. In this episode, Leo will tell us his entrepreneurial journey, his path as a public speaker and a sports enthusiast.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十三集 遁世情懷．名士風流
programme.desc: 魏晉南北朝世道紛亂，道家隱逸精神成為士大夫安身立命、追求精神自由的選擇。本集三件作品——宋代摹本《洛神賦圖》、南朝《竹林七賢與榮啟期磚畫》、唐末孫位《高逸圖》——由魏晉到唐末，反覆演繹相近的遁世主題。《洛神賦圖》源自曹植的文學名篇，東晉顧愷之以其「高古游絲描」將仕途失意化作神話式自況；竹林七賢磚畫以「穿越」方式將七位隱士與春秋人物榮啟期並置，是名士對隱遁行為的價值肯定；孫位《高逸圖》創作於唐末亂世，再次印證遁世情懷的永恆魅力.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: An increasing number of people are viewing AI as a "confidant" for sharing their innermost thoughts and seeking emotional support. Tech companies like Gemini, Grok, and Google are racing to enhance AI's psychological features. This reflects not just technological advancement, but a deep-seated demand for emotion and connection in modern life. . This episode explores extreme global cases stemming from AI emotional companionship, highlighting news stories of overreliance and fraud to warn against potential risks. Additionally, cybersecurity experts offer insights into privacy concerns and authenticity issues that users must navigate when relying on these "AI confidants.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 成日腹痛、肚脹，又經常肚瀉或便秘，以為是病從口入，吃壞肚皮!其實可能是患上「腸易激綜合症」這個都市病！過去有研究顯示，本港約有6.6%人士確診此症，當中以女性患者偏多一些。很多人在患病初期，誤以為是腸胃炎等疾病，沒有對症下藥，導致越醫越失望，更甚會影響情緒，令病情加劇。究竟「腸易激綜合症」跟一般腸胃炎有何分別？今集節目會邀請註冊中醫，從中醫角度講解病理，並對照西醫理解，教大家如何按症狀做辨證分型。另外，嘉賓亦會講解近年以「中西醫結合」治療這個病的成效，究竟為患者擺脫「玻璃肚」的體質有多大成效?. 主持：鄭萃雯、胡志遠醫生. 嘉賓：張學斌教授(香港浸會大學中醫藥學院中醫臨床教授).

programme.title: 香港故事: 樂地生根
programme.desc: 澳洲陶藝家Aby與汕頭妻子陳勤，因在香港修讀視覺藝術碩士而結緣，婚後在此誕下結晶。他們落戶南丫島模達灣，開墾小農田自給自足，更將島上的泥土化為創作原料，燒製成獨一無二的陶藝作品。香港這座文化交匯的城市，讓他們無需在語言上互相依附，能各自獨立生活、隨時出行看展。除了島上的隱世生活，他們更與散居香港各區的本地藝術家交心，建立起一個打破地域限制、互相支援的藝術圈子。這份自由與情誼，讓他們在都市與田園間，真正落地生根。. . #香港#家#陶藝#視覺藝術#藝術家#香港故事#港台電視31#香港電台.

programme.title: 太陽小記者- 2026西域記
programme.desc: 新彊吸引之處在於其多元文化；從熱情奔放的民族風情，到巧奪天工的非遺手藝，非遺文化不只是博物館裏的展品，太陽使者透過親身體驗，感受活在當下的文化傳承。他們又到訪林則徐紀念館，凝視着一件件珍貴的歷史文物，深切感受林則徐的愛國情懷與浩然正氣。到了旅程最後一站–結業禮，大家懷著興奮的心情把成品展示，也帶著不捨的淚水互相祝福，旅程雖然結束了，但這份難離難捨的羈絆，已經深深烙印在他們的青春裏。《太陽計劃》留給大家的，不只是一趟旅程，而是日後點亮人生的珍貴片段，回憶那年盛夏的暑假，他們在新疆遇上了一段燦爛之旅，燦爛的不只是風景，是踏出去的勇氣。. 主持：阮頌陽嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.title: 林則徐：虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 本集從香港中環的砵典乍街出發，追尋一份塵封的關鍵書信——林則徐致英國女王的信函，揭開一段牽動香港命運的歷史序幕。節目主持踏訪香港抗英前哨戰的歷史現場，回望林則徐當年力主修建炮台保衛香港的往事。透過歷史學家的深度解析，重現虎門海域的歷史風雲，探討時代背景下中英雙方的角力。鏡頭穿梭於現代香港的繁華景象與靜默的歷史印記之間，探究林則徐對香港這片土地的深切關注，並尋找那些可能隱藏於城市脈絡中的歷史痕跡.

BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第一百七十三集 - Wheel 仔潛意識植入計劃！
programme.desc: 第一百七十三集-Wheel 仔潛意識植入計劃！. BobieLand眾人開會，討論為何Wheel 仔的行為近日變得愈來愈自我中心。花哩碌指出像Wheel 仔這類物種，天生是沒有同理心。園長 Kevin 哥哥決定進行「Inception 潛意識植入計劃」，進入 Wheel 仔夢境中的潛意識世界，將「同理心」這個概念，植入他的腦中！. 【故事時間】「不可思議的朋友」. 今集請來特别嘉賓～香港教育大學幼兒教育學系副教授林俊彬博士 Ian 哥哥，為大家講述「不可思議的朋友」這本故事書。故事中的主角小安，是一名自閉症患者，小安剛上小學，在新環境中表現得格格不入，同學太田佑介以及周邊人對他的古怪行為顯得不甚理解。故事之外，Ian 哥哥會為大家講解自閉症的資訊，讓大家明白自閉症患者的行為與想法，以及背後的原因。. 編導:區達開.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 十歲的關家浚遇上麻煩，因他沒有做家課而被老師訓斥。他的作業是什麼？就是在周末寫一篇題為「當我長大成人」的文章。這個題目難倒他，雖然題目聽起來簡單，但卻令他困惑，不知如何下筆。. 「雖然母親沒有大聲說出來，但我相信她希望我說自己想成為醫生。不過，她的童年志向又是什麼？是否也想成為醫生？婆婆經常稱讚任職工程師的表叔，因為他可吩咐所有人工作。婆婆小時候又曾否希望成為工程師？」. 可憐的家浚在苦思之際，婆婆提議他出外郊遊，清醒一下頭腦。然而，家浚不單沒有感到平靜，反而遇到一個奇怪的老人，差點把他嚇死—老人甚至闖進他的夢中！. 「我的志願」變成最困難的作業題目。這個故事讓我們記起自己的童年夢想。你又如何？你希望長大成人後做什麼.

programme.title: 童真無國界

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十三集 遁世情懷．名士風流
programme.desc: 魏晉南北朝世道紛亂，道家隱逸精神成為士大夫安身立命、追求精神自由的選擇。本集三件作品——宋代摹本《洛神賦圖》、南朝《竹林七賢與榮啟期磚畫》、唐末孫位《高逸圖》——由魏晉到唐末，反覆演繹相近的遁世主題。《洛神賦圖》源自曹植的文學名篇，東晉顧愷之以其「高古游絲描」將仕途失意化作神話式自況；竹林七賢磚畫以「穿越」方式將七位隱士與春秋人物榮啟期並置，是名士對隱遁行為的價值肯定；孫位《高逸圖》創作於唐末亂世，再次印證遁世情懷的永恆魅力.

programme.title: 林則徐：虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 本集聚焦林則徐一段較少為人談論的非凡貢獻——他臨危受命的治水功績。. 1841年黃河決堤，被流放途中的林則徐臨危受命，奔赴開封搶險。節目深入河南張灣村，實地探尋靜臥於此的「林公堤」遺址。透過村民與學者，走近那個特殊的時刻，了解身負「罪臣」之名的林則徐如何率眾治理黃河洪水的感人細節。隨後，鏡頭轉向福州，回到林則徐的出生之地，聆聽其後人講述關於「兩件傳家寶」和「十無益」家訓等家族故事，揭示清貧家風如何塑造其清廉品格與家國情懷.

programme.desc: 第一百七十四集-Wheel 仔潛意識植入計劃！. 眾人準備就緒，等待目標人物 Wheel 仔出現，希望可以令他沉沉睡著，然後進入他夢境中的潛意識世界。可是 Wheel 仔一直沒有現身，眾人緊張之際，原來 Wheel 仔因為玩得太累，一早已經睡著。眾人把握機會，利用新發明進入他的潛意識世界！. 【故事時間】「不可思議的朋友」. 承接昨日的故事書環節，今集繼續有林俊彬博士 Ian 哥哥為小朋友講故事。故事講述患有自閉症的小安，在小學畢業後升上中學及踏進社會工作的情況。有不熟悉小安的人，會對他的行為感怪異，甚至嬲怒，但原來自閉症患者亦會懂得感受別人的情緒。故事結尾小安重遇舊同學太田佑介，小安一窩心舉動令太田佑介大為感動。Ian哥哥亦教授大家和自閉症患者的相處方法，例如要給予空間讓自閉症患者自己平靜下來。. 編導:區達開.

programme.desc: 當他最親愛的姐姐丹妮雅(24歲)宣布訂婚時，小男孩丹尼爾(9歲)必須面對強烈的被遺棄感與嫉妒情緒，而這些情感幾乎破壞了他們原本緊密的關係。最終，他學習到無條件的愛與接納的真正意義.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 在一個生氣勃勃的城市住宅區，垃圾怪獸跟着一羣正面對日益嚴重的廢物及環境忽視問題的小童和居民。故事始於一個驚險有趣的經歷，小童幻想被一隻「垃圾怪獸」追着—象徵他們周遭充斥着廢物。. 地區統籌員宣布舉辦清潔比賽，鼓勵居民對環境承擔責任。起初小童和大人都不屑一顧，倚賴清潔員工且不理亂拋垃圾的後果。然而，通過幽默和真誠的互動—特別是與電子修理員祖叔叔的互動—居民開始明白廢物管理的重要性。. 小童知道塑膠廢物的危害、有機與無機垃圾的分別，以及對環境的長遠影響。他們參觀了一個大型垃圾場，親身目睹未受管理的廢物如何變成「垃圾海」，從而加強了垃圾怪獸的比喻作用。. 居民受到啟發，攜手清潔四周地方，用創意將膠樽改造為燈籠，轉廢為美。故事以公布比賽得獎者作結，但真正的勝利在於合力保持清潔，以及培養環保意識.

programme.title: 非凡人物
programme.sub-title: 非凡人物｜乾淨等於潔癖？乾淨等於高尚？深度拆解精神潔癖｜講座教授文潔華｜潔癖文化
programme.desc: 「乾淨」不只是洗手！到底什麼是「精神潔癖」？ 後疫情年代，你是否也成了「消毒狂人」？洗手洗到脫皮、見到污糟就心慌？原來「潔癖」不止關乎衛生，背後更是對安全感與確定感的追求！ 今集《非凡人物》請來人文學講座教授文潔華，和作家米哈、臨床心理學家梁重皿及大學講師葉德平，暢談潔癖文化 —— 由古人的潔癖，再到現代社會如何用「乾淨」劃分階級。是否觸及社群的道德底線就要被「取消」？什麼是「取消文化」？ 想睇更多： https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/theextraordinary 逢星期六、日｜下午 1:05 ｜港台電視 31 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg 記得 LIKE +訂閱 + 推播通知！ #非凡人物 #潔癖文化 #文潔華 #米哈 #葉德平 #梁重皿 #清潔 #整潔 #洗手 #斷捨離 #社會階級 #精神潔癖 #道德 #取消文化 #港台電視31.

programme.title: 林則徐：虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 本集跟隨林則徐流放新疆的漫足跡，從西安啟程，西出嘉峪雄關，穿越蒼茫的星星峽，直至天山深處。. 節目將重現其「苟利國家生死以」的離愁別緒，並在戈壁風雪中體驗戍途的孤寂與艱辛。通過探訪哈密回王城、瞭墩烽燧，講述林則徐在新疆平冤獄、獻良策的事蹟。透過學者的視角，解讀這位昔日海防重臣，如何轉而關注塞防安危，預言沙俄邊疆隱患，展現其身處困厄仍以民為本、心懷家國天下的遼闊胸懷.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第一百七十五集 - Wheel仔潛意識植入計劃！
programme.desc: 第一百七十五集-Wheel仔潛意識植入計劃！. 眾人來到Wheel 仔夢境中的潛意識世界，發現情景與 BobieLand一樣。眾人開始尋找與「同理心」有關線索之際，Wheel 仔突然出現！為了爭取時間，園長碌碌姐姐提議與 Wheel 仔玩遊戲，希望分散注意力令其他人有時間找線索。怎料Wheel 仔要全部人和他一起玩，眾人無奈但只好硬著頭皮陪著玩。. 【反轉科學】. 白醋是日常生活常見的用品，除了食用價值之外，還可以用來做很多有趣的實驗。而當白醋加上梳打粉，還會產生有趣的化學反應！. 【手作 Easy Job】. 園長 Sarah 姐姐利用卡紙和彈力線，做出有趣的 pop up 小盒，還可以加上自己喜愛的裝飾！來吧，齊齊pop up！. 編導:區達開.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 馬克及其摯友Jeng均有弱視，他們是一所盲人學校的學生。有一天，Jeng看見馬克觀看抖音的DJ影片，便鼓勵馬克拍片，但馬克猶豫。Jeng所有朋友都想拍片，但只有馬克的電話可上網。馬克在朋友的要求下答應拍片，但條件是他只擔任攝影師，而不會在片中出現。. 他們一起上傳了首段影片，吸引了大量觀眾及支持者。他們招募更多朋友參與，並成功製作了很多影片。Jeng希望觀眾亦見到馬克，於是偷拍他，令馬克感到不舒服。馬克試圖取回電話但Jeng抗拒，令電話掉下，一切歡樂告終。. 沒有人知道馬克心裏有陰影，害怕在表演時被人取笑。老師在班上叫馬克唸詩，他遲疑和默不作聲。他的朋友突然開始打拍子，就像拍片時一樣，馬克最終完成表演，這次沒有人笑他，只有歡呼喝彩聲.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 阿寶是一名十歲小孩，性格反叛，生於一個富有家庭。他妒忌妹妹，不喜歡她；在校內亦與所有人難以溝通，又妒忌班長孫克，並誘使他觸犯校規。當他聽到孫克被短暫停學的消息時，起初感到高興；但三星期後開始想念他。有一天，當阿寶到孫克家中解釋一些課堂情況時，親眼目睹孫克在家中擔起長兄為父的責任。最後，阿寶以孫克為榜樣，培育自己的德行.

programme.title: 林則徐：虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 本集深入新疆伊犁，追尋林則徐貶謫歲月中留下的深刻印記。. 透過文史學者與水利專家的講述，了解他如何傾力協助修築關鍵水道（後世尊稱為「林公渠」）、並親身參與勘地六十萬畝的艱辛歷程。節目亦走訪依存古法的坎兒井村落與阿克蘇稻田，回望林則徐當年推廣農業技術、以實幹精神惠澤邊疆百姓的點滴往事。鏡頭穿梭於現代水利工程與歷史遺址之間，印證林則徐「興疆穩邊」的遠見卓識，及其與各族民眾締結的深厚情誼.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第一百七十六集 - Wheel仔潛意識植入計劃！
programme.desc: 第一百七十六集-Wheel仔潛意識植入計劃！. 眾人在 Wheel 仔夢境中的潛意識世界，被精力無限的Wheel仔強迫玩著不同的遊戲，令眾人筋竭力疲。正當眾人不知所措之際， Wheel 仔再一次在玩樂中沉沉睡著。眾人大喜，立刻四處尋找「同理心」的線索，最後，他們找到一個關鍵小盒～究竟內裡藏著什麼？. 【嘉賓來了】. 來到星期四，有嘉賓來了的環節。今集請來中國香港新興運動協會創辦人黎廣業，教授大家芬蘭木棋的玩法，跟同樣是芬蘭木棋愛好者的一對子女，一起推廣及分享新興運動的苦與樂。. 【冷知識】. 嬰兒在哪個年紀會有同理心行為出現？外國有研究，原來在 12－15 個月的嬰兒，已經會出現同理心，而且與父母的行為有密切關係。. 編導:區達開.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 阿卡莉是個10歲女孩，她希望在親愛的父親生日當天用自己儲的錢送他一隻腕錶。為了儲滿豬仔錢罌，她尋找各種賺錢機會。她通過幫助母親縫製樹葉盤子賺錢，又在學校舉辦的繪畫比賽中贏得獎金。. 然而，阿卡莉未能實現送父親腕錶的願望，因為她把儲到的錢贈予父親的朋友，以助其應對緊急醫療狀況。. 雖然沒有物質上的禮物，但阿卡莉自己就是父母的禮物。父母珍視她的高尚情操和同理心，多於她本可送給他們的任何實質禮物.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 成為父親是每個男孩的夢想。其中一個擁有這個夢想的小孩是八歲的阿文。有一天，他一覺醒來，日子變得不尋常。他似乎成為了父親，開始創業。身為父親，他關心子女，並向父母請教。他作為父親，為子女竭盡所能，從而明白到作為父親並非易事.

programme.desc: 從昔日製造業黃金時代，到今天新型工業化浪潮，「香港製造」該如何重塑核心競爭力？本集繼續有新田科技城主席查毅超，解釋如何善用100億資金，落實三大策略：先進科技驅動、片區開發模式及生產性服務業支援。主持陳祖恒帶我們窺探科技城如何推動產業群聚，對接「南金融、北創科」，為香港經濟注入動力！ 想睇更多： https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt32/programme/onbroadcastdrive/ 逢星期五｜晚上七點半｜港台電視32 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知 #陳祖恒 #查毅超 #新田科技城 #北都 #拆牆鬆綁 #創科磁石 #高產值企業 #落戶 #經濟.

programme.title: 動物福利企劃: 阿Meow奇遇記
programme.desc: 陰差陽錯下，女明星明禎跟自己的寵物貓阿Meow靈魂互換了！原來一切都是「寵物精靈」靈靈狗的詭計！. 話說在很久很久以前，靈靈狗只是一隻普通的寵物小狗，可惜遇上一位不懂照顧寵物的主人，令牠一直受苦，最終出走，修煉成「寵物精靈」。有一天，心懷怨念的靈靈狗暗中觀看人間，看見明禎十分愛惜自己的小貓，靈靈狗深信「天下烏鴉一樣黑」，認為她有朝一日也會對阿Meow失去愛心，故此他施展法術，令明禎跟阿Meow的靈魂交換，好讓阿Meow得到「釋放」，一嘗做主人的滋味。. 然而，披上人類外表的阿Meow，一心只想拯救主人，還原各自身份。靈靈狗告訴她，若要破除魔法，必需在一日之內找到足夠數量之「懂得善待動物的人」！為求回復本來面貌，阿Meow在靈靈狗神出鬼沒的監視下，勇敢踏上征途了！. 行動時，本是貓咪的阿Meow每當遇到吸引小貓的東西時，便會忍不住露出貓的反應；同樣，靈靈狗亦會不時受環境影響，露出小狗的神態，鬧出許多驚險與笑話.

國寶時刻
programme.desc: 鷺鳥紋彩色蠟染衣裙1987年出土於貴州平壩棺材洞，屬明代文物，由上衣與下裙構成，集拼布、蠟染、刺繡技藝於一身，是貴州現存最早的彩色蠟染刺繡實物。衣裙以藍、白、黃多彩交輝，突破傳統靛藍單色定式，飾有翔鷺、草木走獸等紋樣，蘊含苗族古人對自然的崇拜。此衣裙見證明代衛所屯田帶動的物資流通與技藝提升，體現民族文化交融的深厚內涵.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 秦始皇陵將軍俑1974年出土於陝西臨潼，高1.96米，頭戴鶡冠，身披魚鱗鎧甲，昂首挺立，為秦軍區域指揮官，象徵秦帝國赫赫軍威。同地出土之百戲俑則上身赤裸，下身穿着短褲或者彩裙，姿態各異，生動展現秦代宮廷摔跤、樂舞等百戲表演。將軍俑與百戲俑一武一文，一面鐵血軍陣，一面樂舞歡暢，共同折射出秦朝不同側影，為研究秦代社會文化提供珍貴實物見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯1970年出土於陝西西安何家村窖藏，屬唐代文物。杯體以罕見瑪瑙製成，呈獸首造型，形似橫放的牛角或平臥的羚羊，嘴部鑲金塞，紋理自然流暢。此杯造型與西亞、地中海的「來通」酒具極度相似，可能為中亞或西亞進貢之物，或由外來工匠於長安製作。它既是唐代宮廷的實用酒器，亦見證絲綢之路上的文明交流，反映唐朝開放包容、融匯多元文化的恢弘氣度.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 蓮鶴方壺1923年出土於河南新鄭李家樓，是春秋時期的鄭公大墓。方壺高117厘米，重64公斤，壺身呈橢長方形，飾有蟠龍紋；壺頂為十瓣雙層蓮瓣，中央立有一隻展翅欲飛的仙鶴，造型靈動，融合商周青銅器的獰厲威嚴與楚文化的寫實浪漫。此壺以分鑄焊接之術熔鑄周禮、楚風與中原文化於一身，是春秋時期多元文化交融的縮影，亦是青銅鑄造技藝的典範.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.desc: 新石器時代三件文物，見證先民由「生存」走向「生活」的精神飛躍。七孔骨笛證實音樂早於文字；雙體陶罐反映地域文明交流；蛋殼黑陶杯薄至0.2毫米，是權力萌芽的物證。音樂、信仰與技藝，打開中華文明的序幕.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 七孔骨笛1987年出土於河南賈湖遺址，距今約八千餘年，以丹頂鶴尺骨製成，長22.7厘米，七孔，音域橫跨兩個八度，半音階齊全，是至今中國發現最早、保存最完整的吹管樂器。骨笛可演奏五聲調式及西域樂曲，反映新石器時代已具備七聲音階觀念。賈湖人在無金屬工具下，憑反覆度量打磨，精準開孔調音，展現非凡智慧。此笛既是狩獵誘具，亦是祭祀神器，見證中華禮樂文明的曙光.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 翔鷺紋銅鼓1976年出土於廣西貴縣羅泊灣1號墓，鑄造於西漢初年，屬石寨山型銅鼓代表作。鼓面中心為十二芒太陽紋，主暈是銜魚翔鷺紋，鼓胸刻有羽人划船紋，鼓腰畫上羽人舞蹈紋，紋飾生動寫實。此鼓採用合範鑄造工藝，體現西漢時期南方青銅鑄造技術的高度水準。銅鼓是古代南方民族權力與財富的象徵，亦是中華民族多元文化交融的歷史見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 鑲嵌綠松石獸面紋銅牌飾
programme.desc: 鑲嵌綠松石獸面紋銅牌飾1984年出土於河南省偃師縣二里頭遺址，屬於夏朝中晚期文物，長16.5厘米，闊11厘米，主體以青銅鑄造，牌飾上鑲有五百餘片綠松石，拼合嚴密，歷數千年無一鬆脫。牌面獸目圓睜，造型威嚴神秘，展現早期神靈崇拜意象。此器集鑄造與鑲嵌工藝於一身，反映二里頭時期高超的青銅與玉石複合加工技術，是夏朝文明及中原與周邊文化交流的重要見證.

programme.title: 看神州

programme.desc: 內地的照顧護理需求近年急增，國家推出養老服務消費補貼，每月為年滿60歲中度及以上的失能人士，提供最多800元，用於助浴、陪診等服務。「助浴師」等行業興起，大大減輕了照顧者的責任，有電商平台更有意將相關護理服務擴展至香港。. 北上就醫亦是港人熱門之選，不過內地傳媒發現，有醫院的專家預約籌號被「秒搶光」，背後涉及「黃牛黨」炒籌，破壞就醫秩序。. 新修訂的《住房公積金管理條例》早前正式實施，由原來的6種提取情況，增加至9種，包括裝修、租樓，專家認為，修例對內房市場起到穩定作用，亦帶來財富效應，支撐內需。. 甘肅敦煌一家壁畫研習室，讓旅客沉浸式體驗當地壁畫的千年歷史文化藝術；河南鄭州有義工設置地攤教導民眾急救知識，令更多人可以在危急關頭施以援手.

programme.desc: 2026為APEC中國年，香港將於10月20至21日首次承辦APEC財長會，迎來逾500名來自各成員經濟體的財金官員與代表，共商區域經濟、普惠金融及數字基建融資等議題。. 一眾年輕公務員投入會議籌備，由場地安排、嘉賓接待到文化參訪活動逐一統籌，向全球代表展示香港專業、多元的城市面貌。香港商界亦透過APEC商貿諮詢理事會，把業界關注的跨境支付、電子貿易文件、數字基建等訴求，帶進亞太區域合作平台。. 在全球貿易保護主義升溫的大環境下，背靠祖國、聯通世界的香港，怎樣透過APEC這個國際平台，進一步鞏固國際金融中心與「超級聯繫人」地位？首次承辦APEC財長會，又會為香港開拓甚麼新機遇.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: When out in the city, public toilets are essential. Each year on World Toilet Day, the Hong Kong Toilet Association announces the “Best Public Toilet Awards.” In 2025, Lan Kwai Fong’s public toilet won Gold among 300 contenders, with Kam Tin in Yuen Long and Gough Street Garden in Sai Wan taking Silver and Bronze. The Association also named the “Most Urgently Needing Improvement Toilets,” criticised for poor hygiene. This episode uses Hong Kong’s public toilet development to explore urban civilisation.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 -- 土耳其篇 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Crowds Among Ancient Stones: Ephesus and a Taste of Turkish Wine
programme.desc: The coastal city of Izmir, Türkiye’s third largest, sits along the Aegean Sea. Throughout history, it has been ruled by the Greeks, Alexander the Great, the Eastern Roman Empire, and the Ottoman Turks. This blend of cultures has shaped Izmir into a unique city where history and modern life intertwine. Vicky and Meka finally arrive at one of their most anticipated destinations: the ancient Roman city of Ephesus, located eighty kilometres from Izmir. In the 2nd century AD, under Roman rule, Ephesus reached its peak, sprawling over 2,000 hectares. Most of the ruins seen today date back to that golden era. Wandering among these ancient structures, Vicky and Meka get a glimpse into the daily lives of both the elite and common citizens of the time. Izmir is also famed for its vineyards. In the charming town of Urla, Vicky and Meka visit a local winery to savour some Turkish wine, soak in the sun-drenched spirit of the Aegean coast, and join in the festivities of Türkiye’s 101st National Day—celebrating with locals under a sky filled with fireworks.

programme.title: 口述澳門歷史名人堂
programme.desc: 賈梅士，1524年生於葡萄牙里斯本，曾因為征戰沙場而失去右眼，傳說他在1556年來到澳門，在澳門居住了兩年，並在白鴿巢公園石洞創作著名敘事長詩《葡國魂》，他的文學作品成為後世千古傳重的篇章.

programme.title: 口述澳門歷史名人堂
programme.desc: 利瑪竇於1552年出生於意大利，1582年應召前往中國傳道，澳門是他踏進中華大地的第一站!他畢生努力傳揚信仰，促進中西方文化交流，被稱為西學東漸第一人。澳門利氏學社社長羅世范神父﹑天主教澳門教區歷史檔案及文物處葉家祺主任，及澳門理工大學人文及社會科學學院院長林發欽教授，在節目內講述利瑪竇神父無私奉獻的精神!

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航 (英文版)
programme.desc: This episode uses birdsong to explore Hong Kong’s rich avian world. Nature educators Matthew and Hoiling visit Sha Tin Central Park to demonstrate how to identify birds by tuning into nature’s frequencies amidst urban noise. They also feature bird species from Tai Mo Shan at the Flow with Big Mountain exhibition in Koon Man Space. Meanwhile, Jay, a Research Officer at the Hong Kong Bird Watching Society, uses ecoacoustic techniques in Hok Tau. By recording countryside birdsong and training AI to identify species, this research helps unlock the mysteries of the natural world.

programme.title: 領遊香港 2
programme.desc: Some people call Colombia “South America's gateway to the world”, while some call it the “coffee capital of the world”. However, it’s the unique vitality of Colombian music that has given the country the name it’s proudest of: “the land of a thousand rhythms”. . Colombia’s colourful carnival culture originates from the harvest celebrations of its various indigenous tribes, with historical events such as colonisation and nation-building giving rise to an array of ethnically diverse elements. Mr Luís Orozco, Consul General of Colombia in Hong Kong and Macau, will take us on a cultural journey of his homeland, starting with its festive foods and music. Meanwhile, our presenter Chris will take him to the southernmost part of our city, Po Toi Island, known as the “Antartica of Hong Kong”, to participate in the traditional Po Toi Jiao Festival celebrated by the local fisherfolk. . We will also introduce viewers to Ingrid, an accessories designer who has been living in Hong Kong for many years. Through her works, she showcases traditional Colombian craftsmanship and her compatriots’ passion for life not only to Hongkongers but people from around the world.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 由宋羅孟君女士（宋太）創辦的喜樂餐飲.教室，多年來為自閉症患者及有特殊需要人士提供工作及培訓機會，每天早上，宋太都會和患有自閉症及輕度智障的女兒Flora一同去「喜樂」開店，其後員工陸續到場，包括在「喜樂」工作多年的，患有中度智能障礙的「大師兄」陸永傑；與媽媽一同上班，雖然患有腦瘤但總是笑容滿面的張鎧晴，以及其他殘疾員工等。. 對宋太來說，這班員工不只是她的工作伙伴，更是情同家人。公司會定期為他們安排各種「課外活動」，員工的照顧者亦會被邀請同遊，令他們都得以享受親子樂。. 作為單親媽媽的宋太，當年因為女兒畢業後找不到工作的經歷，啟發到她為殘疾人士創辦可以安心工作的空間，助力他人的同時亦找到新的人生目標，希望「區區有喜樂」，用自己的每一分力量照亮弱勢社群的人生。. 這次「同行者」陳柏宇（Jason )會與「喜樂」一班員工一同解鎖「不可能的任務」，到底他們能否挑戰成功，令宋太與一眾照顧者有意外之喜.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航 (英文版)
programme.desc: This episode uses birdsong to explore Hong Kong’s rich avian world. Nature educators Matthew and Hoiling visit Sha Tin Central Park to demonstrate how to identify birds by tuning into nature’s frequencies amidst urban noise. They also feature bird species from Tai Mo Shan at the Flow with Big Mountain exhibition in Koon Man Space. Meanwhile, Jay, a Research Officer at the Hong Kong Bird Watching Society, uses ecoacoustic techniques in Hok Tau. By recording countryside birdsong and training AI to identify species, this research helps unlock the mysteries of the natural world.

programme.title: 領遊香港 2
programme.desc: Some people call Colombia “South America's gateway to the world”, while some call it the “coffee capital of the world”. However, it’s the unique vitality of Colombian music that has given the country the name it’s proudest of: “the land of a thousand rhythms”. . Colombia’s colourful carnival culture originates from the harvest celebrations of its various indigenous tribes, with historical events such as colonisation and nation-building giving rise to an array of ethnically diverse elements. Mr Luís Orozco, Consul General of Colombia in Hong Kong and Macau, will take us on a cultural journey of his homeland, starting with its festive foods and music. Meanwhile, our presenter Chris will take him to the southernmost part of our city, Po Toi Island, known as the “Antartica of Hong Kong”, to participate in the traditional Po Toi Jiao Festival celebrated by the local fisherfolk. . We will also introduce viewers to Ingrid, an accessories designer who has been living in Hong Kong for many years. Through her works, she showcases traditional Colombian craftsmanship and her compatriots’ passion for life not only to Hongkongers but people from around the world.

大自然大不同3
programme.desc: Parasitism means that one benefits the other and the other suffers from it. As being highly efficient is one of the most successful ways of surviving, many species have adapted to live the parasite lifestyle.

programme.title: 保監說道
programme.desc: 香港保險業一直處於全球領先的地位，保險滲透率和保險密度都是全球數一數二。保險對於社會的正常運作非常重要，無論個人和商戶，在不同的處境和人生階段都會面對不同風險，做好風險管理便可以減低遇到風險事故時的損失。要令保險能夠發揮其社會作用，保障市場必須維持高度誠信的文化，不論是保險公司或前線的保險中介人，都須具備良好的道德操守及專業水平，確保每位投保人都能得到公平的對待。本集請來香港保險中介人商會前會長莊文玲女士現身說道，一起探討保險中介人的責任和操守.

programme.desc: 十八好時光.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到（英文版）
programme.desc: Hong Kong-based Japanese illustrator Mango Naoko studied art at university in Japan. In 2013, she moved to the city with her Hong Kong husband. With different cultures and habits, it has taken some time for the couple to adjust to each other. Mango writes about her married life in a blog, sharing with her readers her ups and downs of marriage. . When Mango first came to Hong Kong, she was not used to life here. She did not understand Cantonese and she did not have many friends. She was unable to find a job. As a pastime, she went to a café every day to have coffee and draw. The owner of the café saw her work one day and invited her to exhibit her drawings in the shop. . Mango likes to put cats of different postures and looks into urban landscape. For example, there are cats in local public housing estates, cha chaan teng (Hong Kong style cafe) and dai pai dong (open-air food stalls).

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Hong Kong generates around 11,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste (MSW) daily, most of which ends up in landfills. With limited land resources and ever-increasing waste, landfills are approaching full capacity. To tackle this, the government has accelerated the development of "Waste to Energy" facilities, such as incinerators (I·PARKs), sludge treatment facilities (T·PARK), and organic waste recovery centres (O·PARKs). These aim to reduce landfill reliance and turn waste into valuable resources. . Incineration technology, already widely used overseas, will soon be introduced to Hong Kong with the completion of the first next-generation incinerator (I·PARK1) in 2025. It is expected to process 3,000 tonnes of MSW daily and convert waste into electricity. Older incinerators were known to release harmful pollutants like dioxins, but how will this new technology minimizes emissions? What other environmental policies can support its implementation.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: 打鼓嶺 – 香園與竹園
programme.desc: 一個口岸，兩條村莊，跨代原居民，對「變」與「不變」，行出南轅北轍的不同方向。香園圍口岸，香港與深圳之間第七個跨境陸路口岸，於2023年正式全面開通。為興建口岸，打鼓嶺區內的竹園村需全村遷移，而與口岸同名的香園圍，則原地保留。. 被遷的，要離開故鄉土地，卻換來現代化的生活配套；留守的，能保持原有的傳統和文化，但失去改善生活質素的機會。究竟，兩地人、兩代人，哪個才是他們的理想.

programme.title: 亞洲TOP TEN 台灣篇
programme.desc: Erica繼續介紹台灣特式早餐，先到基隆品嚐蚵仔煎配排骨酥，仲有超巨型特產鮮蝦燒賣，又到一間充滿富士山特式小店食土石流肉蛋土司，滿滿臭豆腐味加上爆醬汁，早餐來講太利害。再到熟食市場排隊食厚燒餅，糯米水餃，仲有唔係人人啱食嘅大麵羹，味道特別。.
